_comment: The dived sub's concealment, measured (DERIVATION 41). Fixture: savestate
slot 2 (P2's turn), fog written OFF (0x0300431D = 0). Row y=7 written
to Sea from x=6 to x=10 and (7,6) too; P2's Tank 71 at (9,7) typed
Cruiser (RAM 22); on P1's turn the Mech 3 at (7,6) typed Sub (RAM 24),
real-moved to (7,7) (or (8,7)) and dived through its own menu (Wait /
Dive; Fire / Wait / Dive when adjacent to the Cruiser). Grids are the
game's move-select grid at [0x03003600+y*4][x] read with the Cruiser
selected: cost spent, 255 (-1) unreachable. Scripts: mesen_subhide.lua,
The game's check is 0x08023BFC (1 = shown, 0 = hidden): not dived -> 1;
else 1 if the owner's army has +0x1C bit 1 (the ACTIVE player -- it read
03 on the active army and 00 on the other, on both P1's and P2's turns),
or the terrain byte's owner (>>5) has it, or any of the four adjacent
tiles holds a unit (tile->unit index map+0x51A) whose owner has it.

drives.reading: a surfaced enemy blocks: (7,7) and (6,7) unreachable
hidden: not drawn, the tile reads as empty, the fill enters it at cost 2 AND expands through it -- (6,7) and (7,6) at 3. Unlike the fog ambush, which never expands through a hidden tile.
a hunter that ends its move adjacent gets no Fire that action; at menu time the tile index still holds its origin, two tiles away
the ambush: stops one tile short, fuel for the tiles walked, action spent, no menu
a path through the hidden tile stops where it would enter it
adjacent when the action starts: shown, Fire offered, the dived table's 90 + luck 5. The 5 burn on the dived sub measured again.
the adjacency branch: the sub's tile blocks (shown) and Fire is offered from a standing start

terrain_written.meaning: Port | P2 << 5, written before P1 ended

drives.reading: the property branch: shown on the viewer's own property; a hunter that MOVES adjacent fires the same action because the reveal does not depend on it. 95 * (1 - 0.3 port) = 66.
any unit of the viewer's parked adjacent reveals the sub for everyone that turn; the Cruiser then moves in and fires
